mapper.select: SELECT * FROM (SELECT ID,PARK_ID,METER_SOURCE,METER_ID,RESOURCE_TYPE,UNIT,EFFECTIVE_START_DATE,EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,INCLUDE_FLAG,METER_GROUP_ID,PARENT_METER_ID,RULE_VERSION,REASON,CREATE_TIME,UPDATE_TIME FROM SMT_ENERGY_METER_SCOPE_RULE WHERE METER_SOURCE=#{meterSource} AND METER_ID=#{meterId} AND EFFECTIVE_START_DATE <= #{statDate} AND (EFFECTIVE_END_DATE IS NULL OR EFFECTIVE_END_DATE > #{statDate}) ORDER BY RULE_VERSION DESC,ID DESC) WHERE ROWNUM=1

SELECT ID,PARK_ID,METER_SOURCE,METER_ID,RESOURCE_TYPE,UNIT,EFFECTIVE_START_DATE,EFFECTIVE_END_DATE,INCLUDE_FLAG,METER_GROUP_ID,PARENT_METER_ID,RULE_VERSION,REASON,CREATE_TIME,UPDATE_TIME FROM SMT_ENERGY_METER_SCOPE_RULE WHERE PARK_ID=#{parkId} AND METER_SOURCE=#{meterSource} AND EFFECTIVE_START_DATE <= #{statDate} AND (EFFECTIVE_END_DATE IS NULL OR EFFECTIVE_END_DATE > #{statDate}) ORDER BY METER_ID,RULE_VERSION DESC,ID DESC
